# Scope

This record contains electrochemical impedance spectra (EIS) measured during galvanostatic intermittent titration technique (GITT) steps on the NMC cathode of a commercial LG CHEM INR18650-MJ1 lithium-ion cell. The measurements were conducted at 25°C and are provided in a structured Parquet format, suitable for data analysis workflows and model fitting.

## Files

| Filename                                           | Description                                                                 | Format               | Usage                                                             |
|----------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 18650-LG-3500-MJ1-cathode-GITT-EIS-Ch.parquet      | Structured GITT-EIS spectrum of NMC cathode during charge at 25°C.         | application/parquet    | Use in data science pipelines or impedance modeling.             |
| 18650-LG-3500-MJ1-cathode-GITT-EIS-Dc.parquet      | Structured GITT-EIS spectrum of NMC cathode during discharge at 25°C.      | application/parquet    | Use in data science pipelines or impedance modeling.             |

# Notes
Legend for the dataset column names:
 - "LINE": # of the step in the measurement device script
 - "COMM": type of the step (Charge/Discharge/...); intermittent EIS measurements happen during "Set-Temp", since the measurement device links with the climate chamber
 - "STATE": labels start (3) and end (2) of any step
